name: Adulterers
overview: Scripture clearly condemns adultery as a grievous sin, commanding in Exodus 20:14, "Thou shalt not commit adultery." The Old Testament law prescribes severe consequences for adulterers, including death, as seen in Leviticus 20:10 and Deuteronomy 22:21, emphasizing the seriousness of defiling covenant relationships. Furthermore, Proverbs 6:24 warns believers to guard against the allure of the adulterous woman, highlighting the spiritual danger of such sin. These passages collectively underscore the holiness of marriage and the necessity of faithfulness as an expression of obedience to God.
